overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Council's Dec. 10 executive session under Purpose 3 was supported by the City Solicitor's representation of imminent or demonstrably likely litigation. The AG separately flagged, without deciding, concerns about the meeting notice's wording on the open session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council improperly entered executive session on Dec. 10 under Purpose 3 (litigation strategy) when no litigation was pending or threatened.
allegations.key_passage: we are satisfied that the Council discussed strategy with respect to litigation that the City Solicitor reasonably believed was imminently threatened or otherwise demonstrably likely

allegations.summary: Not raised in the complaint: the meeting notice's statement that the open session would begin only after executive session may have suggested no open session would occur first.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the language at the top of the meeting notice, we are concerned that either the Council did not convene in open session to conduct the required procedural steps, or that the public could have been deterred from attending the open session prior to the executive session

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
